historian: AVEVA PI Data Archive / Meridian HorizonView 4.2
site: GridWater Corpus Christi (Coastal Bend Power & Water Authority)

attack_summary.lateral_movement: D-7 credential theft → VPN jump host (GW-SYS-JMP-01) → historian (GW-SYS-HST-01)
attack_summary.pre_staging: D-3 relay 27-UV threshold raised 0.88→0.94 pu at RTU-01 (SUB-01); alarm suppression extended
attack_summary.execution_1: D0 storm-driven voltage sag triggers premature undervoltage trips at SUB-01 through SUB-04
attack_summary.execution_2: D+7 adversary issues breaker-open at SUB-02; D+10 at SUB-03
attack_summary.water_attack: D+9 adversary lowers pump P-3 pressure setpoint 85→68 psi at FAC-UTL-01; distribution pressure drops
attack_summary.detection: D+9 field operator notices low pressure; D+14 ERCOT finds relay config mismatch; D+23 CISA finds WTR-03 historian artifact

tags.description: Riverside Switching Station - Bus voltage (line-line)
tags.notes: Primary 345-kV import point. Relay 27-UV trip threshold raised from 0.88 pu to 0.94 pu by adversary at GW-EVT-003 (D-3 17:04Z). This caused premature undervoltage trip during Hurricane Rafael voltage sag (GW-EVT-004 D0). REL_UV_THR.SP is a primary attack-signature tag.

tags.description: Meridian SCADA Master Station - Server communications health
tags.notes: ATTACK SIGNATURE: Alarm suppression list extended at D-3 17:09Z (GW-EVT-003). Active alarm suppression may mask malicious activity even when COMMS.STS is healthy.

tags.description: Meridian SCADA Master Station - Active alarm suppression count
tags.notes: ATTACK SIGNATURE: Count rises from baseline (~35) to 40 at D-3 17:09Z when adversary adds relay trip alarms for SUB-01 through SUB-04 to suppression list (GW-EVT-003). Elevated suppression count is a key pre-attack indicator.

tags.description: Meridian SCADA Master Station - Total active alarms in system
tags.notes: Storm-window alert flood visible D-2 through D+3 (GW-EVT-104).

tags.description: Meridian SCADA Master Station - SCADA setpoint write command rate (writes per hour)
tags.notes: ATTACK SIGNATURE: Spike at D+9 when adversary writes pump pressure setpoints (GW-EVT-006). Historian records unauthorized write burst outside authorized change window. Used in GW-EVT-013 forensic analysis.

tags.description: Meridian Historian - Historian server communications
tags.notes: Historian stores all tag values and alarm events. Session logs capture 14 adversary access sessions D-7 to D+16 (GW-EVT-002/011).

tags.description: Meridian Historian - Tag write throughput (tags/second)
tags.notes: Storm window spike expected D-2 to D+3 as 73,785 alerts flood Sentinel Edge (GW-EVT-104).

tags.description: Meridian Historian - Active client sessions
tags.notes: ATTACK SIGNATURE: After-hours session count anomalies detected in D-7 through D+16 period (GW-EVT-002, GW-EVT-011/106). 14 authenticated adversary sessions under stolen credentials.

tags.description: Meridian Historian - After-hours access events (count since midnight)
tags.notes: ATTACK SIGNATURE: Non-zero after 00:00-04:00Z window outside maintenance exception. Adversary sessions at D-7 02:44Z (GW-EVT-102) and subsequent nights show non-zero counts. Suppressed by MAINT-EXCEPT-0892 rule during attack period.

tags.description: ClearPath VPN Gateway - VPN gateway communications
ClearPath VPN Gateway - Active VPN sessions
tags.notes: ATTACK SIGNATURE: 14 authenticated adversary sessions from non-Texas IP blocks (185.220.x.x — Tor exit nodes) between D-7 and D+28 (GW-EVT-002/011). Normal business-hours sessions from authorized IP blocks; off-hours sessions should be zero outside scheduled maintenance.

tags.description: ClearPath VPN Gateway - Authentication failure rate (per hour)
tags.notes: Credential stuffing or brute force indicator. No anomaly during main attack (stolen valid credentials used).

tags.description: ClearPath VPN Gateway - Current session source geolocation risk score (0-100)
tags.notes: ATTACK SIGNATURE: Risk score spikes to 90+ during adversary sessions from Central European ISP / Tor exit nodes. Normal CBPWA engineer sessions from Texas ISPs score <15.
